correctness.rationale: For m>=4 the edge differences are exactly ±1, ±2, and ±2m. The proof classifies all closed three-step and four-step patterns modulo 4m+2. Every triangle is a face; every four-cycle is one of five explicit families, three of which bound two faces. An integral cocycle vanishes on the remaining R and S families while being nonzero on the free quotient, and an independent mod-two cocycle evaluates to one on R and S. Since the source family triangulates the Klein bottle, H1 is Z plus Z/2, forcing every R and S cycle to be the unique order-two class. Counts and translation stabilizers give 4m+2 and 2m+1 carriers, hence 6m+3 total.

value.rationale: This is an all-parameter structural theorem for a natural vertex-transitive Klein-bottle family, not a single finite census. Although H1 has a free summand, every absolutely shortest simple nonzero integral cycle is torsion; the entire minimum shell has the closed formula 6m+3 and exactly two cyclic symmetry orbits. That separates combinatorial systolic behavior from the abstract homology group in a precise infinite family.
